二進で厳密に表現できる16×4行列の条件数を1から2³⁶まで変え、再構成誤差と解誤差を分けます。実際のbinary64入力に対し別環境で実行した80/120桁参照とLAPACKを比較します。 前提・単位・境界 Hadamard直交因子U,Vとsⱼ=2⁻qj、q=0/4/8/12を使います。b=u₀とb+2⁻⁴⁰u_minを固定し、摂動増幅を測ります。q=0の重複特異値では個々の特異ベクトルは一意ではありません。 編集上の補足 再構成・直交性・後退誤差が小さくても、悪条件問題の前進誤差は大きくなり得ます。入力した浮動小数点行列と理想的に指定した特異値を区別し、数値階数の閾値も明記します。 採用した計算法 Householder QR、片側Jacobi SVD、三角後退代入を実装します。SVDの数値階数閾値を10⁻⁸/10⁻¹²/10⁻¹⁴へ変え、同じ切捨て規約のLAPACK解と比較します。正規方程式の計算例は追加していません。 A=Udiag⁡(2−qj)VT,κ2(A)=23qA=Udiag(2−qj)VT,κ2​(A)=23q 確認の限界と失敗条件 LAPACKと教材の射影コアには共通の数値基盤が含まれます。mpmath SVDは別実装の二重対角化とQR反復、mpmath最小二乗は同じHouseholder群の別高精度実装です。どの高条件数行列にも微小特異値の相対高精度を保証するものではありません。 保存した実測値と判定 Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. QR/SVD: prescribed spectra, perturbation gain and numerical rank Vary condition number from 1 to 2³⁶ for exactly representable 16×4 dyadic matrices, separating reconstruction from forward solution error. Compare LAPACK and separately executed 80/120-digit references for the actual binary64 inputs. Assumptions, units and boundaries Use Hadamard orthogonal factors U,V and sⱼ=2⁻qj for q=0/4/8/12. Fixed b=u₀ and b+2⁻⁴⁰u_min measure perturbation amplification. Individual singular vectors are nonunique for the repeated singular values at q=0. Editorial clarification Small reconstruction, orthogonality and backward errors do not ensure small forward error for an ill-conditioned problem. Distinguish the actual floating-point matrix from its intended singular values and state the numerical-rank threshold. Adopted numerical method Implement Householder QR, one-sided Jacobi SVD and triangular back substitution. Vary rank cutoffs 10⁻⁸/10⁻¹²/10⁻¹⁴ and compare with LAPACK solutions using the same truncation convention. No executed normal-equations comparison is added. Runtime SHA and completeness guards check all four inputs at both precisions and never substitute analytic truth after a mismatch. Verification limits and failures Some LAPACK and projected-core numerical infrastructure is shared. mpmath SVD uses separate bidiagonalization and QR iteration; mpmath least squares is a separate high-precision implementation of the same Householder family. Tiny-singular-value relative accuracy is not guaranteed for arbitrary ill-conditioned matrices. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded.
